settings.title: Settings
settings.application.appearance.heading: Appearance
settings.application.theme.title: Theme
settings.application.theme.description: Choose light, dark, or follow system.
settings.application.accent.title: Accent colour
settings.application.accent.description: Buttons, links and the selected chat.
settings.application.neutral.title: Background tone
settings.application.neutral.description: Neutral, cool or warm greys behind the text.
settings.application.language.title: Language
settings.application.language.descriptio: The language the app is shown in. Changing it reloads the page.
settings.application.streaming.title: Streaming mode
settings.application.streaming.descripti: Choose how assistant text appears while generating.
settings.application.paste.title: Paste text directly
settings.application.paste.description: Paste long text directly into chat instead of a file.
settings.application.haptics.title: Haptic feedback
settings.application.haptics.description: Vibrate on taps and actions on supported devices.
settings.application.web_search.title: Web search on by default
settings.application.web_search.descript: New chats start with web search on. Toggling it in a chat changes only that chat.
settings.application.tool_approvals.desc: Whether the assistant may call web_fetch and MCP tools on its own, or asks you first — once per call, with the option to allow a tool for the rest of the conversation. Overridable per chat at the composer.
settings.application.pypi.title: Install packages from PyPI in code execution
settings.application.pypi.description_al: Lets code you run install any pure-Python package from the public PyPI index, not just the ones this deployment vendors. Off by default: code execution runs in your browser, so this is your own call to make.
settings.application.task_model.title: Task model
delete_all_conversations.title: Delete all conversations
delete_all_conversations.body: Are you sure you want to delete all conversations? Chats inside projects are deleted too. This action cannot be undone.
settings.location.heading: Location
settings.location.description: Share where you are so answers about weather, local time and nearby places fit. While sharing is on, your location is sent to the model provider with every message. Off by default.
settings.location.device_note: Uses your browser's location permission. Coordinates are rounded to about 1 km, read when you open a chat, and not stored on the server.
settings.location.denied: Location permission was denied in this browser, so nothing is shared. Allow it in the browser's site settings and choose this option again.
settings.location.unavailable: This device's location is unavailable, so nothing is shared.
settings.usage.unavailable: Usage & billing is not available on this deployment.
settings.usage.billing_group.title: Billing group
settings.usage.billing_group.description: Which group your usage is charged to. You can only choose groups you belong to.
settings.notifications.not_set_up.title: Notifications are not set up on this deployment
settings.notifications.not_set_up.descri: Push needs a key pair that the operator creates once. On the kit, running {#configure}./configure{/configure} mints it and {#compose}docker compose up -d{/compose} applies it. Until then there is nothing to turn on here.
settings.notifications.this_device.title: This device
settings.notifications.this_device.off: Get a notification here when something needs you, even with the app closed.
settings.notifications.tell_me_when.desc: For all your devices. A notification is skipped while you are looking at the app.
A coding agent is waiting for your approval or an answer to a question.
settings.notifications.event.agentTurn.d: A coding agent has been working for more than a minute and a half and stopped.
settings.notifications.event.scheduleRun: A scheduled action ran to its end, or could not run.
settings.notifications.event.backgroundT: A task an agent started in the background ended with an error.
settings.notifications.event.chatTurn.la: A long chat answer is ready
settings.notifications.event.chatTurn.de: A chat reply that took more than a minute and a half finished.
settings.notifications.devices.title: Your devices
settings.notifications.devices.none: No devices yet. Turn notifications on from a browser or the installed app.
settings.notifications.notice.not_set_up: Notifications are not set up here.
settings.notifications.notice.generic_fa: That did not work. Try again.
settings.notifications.notice.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
settings.notifications.notice.disabled: Notifications are off for this device.
settings.notifications.notice.not_taken: The push service did not take it. Try again in a moment.
